method.candidate: Reserve whole pairs near the crop boundaries. Three actual native face samples on each side of both adjacent-picture changes, using the fixed two-edge appearance and motion measurements.
method.comparison: Run the current stationary and moving short proposal first. Compare with a near-end supplement using the same inputs. Keep the current proposal when it selected a range.
method.coverage: Counts use temporal IoU >= 0.5. Exact matches require both native frame indices. Keep unmatched ordinary ranges and insufficient face coverage visible.
method.timeline: Exactly 120 presented 720p pictures at 30 fps, upright 4:2:0 H.264 MP4.
